name: 1 · Suburban Lawn
rule_text: Five lanes, blocked flowerbeds, and the least professional neighborhood watch.

levels.title: 1-01 · Welcome Mat
levels.briefing: Five lanes, blocked flowerbeds, and the least professional neighborhood watch. Establish economy and cover all five lanes.
levels.joke: The welcome mat says hello, not all-you-can-eat. The HOA has banned brains after 9 PM.

levels.title: 1-02 · Sun Is Not a Subscription
levels.briefing: Five lanes, blocked flowerbeds, and the least professional neighborhood watch. Build sun production before doubling your shooters.
levels.joke: Sunlight remains free. The zombie subscription is harder to cancel. Your neighbor insists this is normal lawn aeration.

levels.title: 1-03 · Cone of Shame
levels.briefing: Five lanes, blocked flowerbeds, and the least professional neighborhood watch. A new specialist joins the queue. Read its almanac counter before starting.
levels.joke: Local traffic cone promoted to middle management. The fence contractor accepts payment in screams.

levels.title: 1-04 · The Lawn Doctor
levels.briefing: Five lanes, blocked flowerbeds, and the least professional neighborhood watch. A new specialist joins the queue. Read its almanac counter before starting.
levels.joke: The doctor recommends more brains. Seek a second opinion. A tasteful garden gnome has declined to intervene.

levels.title: 1-05 · Express Delivery
levels.briefing: Five lanes, blocked flowerbeds, and the least professional neighborhood watch. A new specialist joins the queue. Read its almanac counter before starting.
levels.joke: Your delivery is three lanes away and marked delivered. Neighborhood watch is currently watching from indoors.

levels.title: 1-06 · Twenty Is Plenty
levels.briefing: Five lanes, blocked flowerbeds, and the least professional neighborhood watch. Win with at most 20 planting actions, including grafts and rafts.
levels.joke: Twenty plants. Infinite unsolicited gardening opinions. The HOA has banned brains after 9 PM.

levels.title: 1-07 · No Refunds on Roots
levels.briefing: Five lanes, blocked flowerbeds, and the least professional neighborhood watch. Lose no more than 3 plants to attacks or shoveling. Single-use plants do not count.
levels.joke: The roots have formed a union. Please keep them alive. Your neighbor insists this is normal lawn aeration.

levels.title: 1-08 · Wrong Lane, Mate
levels.briefing: Five lanes, blocked flowerbeds, and the least professional neighborhood watch. A new specialist joins the queue. Read its almanac counter before starting.
levels.joke: Turn signals are apparently a living-person feature. The fence contractor accepts payment in screams.

levels.title: 1-09 · The Solar Savings Account
levels.briefing: Five lanes, blocked flowerbeds, and the least professional neighborhood watch. Hold 4000 unspent sun and clear all waves. Collection continues after the last zombie.
levels.joke: Four thousand sun in savings. Still cannot afford a garden shed. A tasteful garden gnome has declined to intervene.

levels.title: 1-10 · Overtime for the Mowers
levels.briefing: Five lanes, blocked flowerbeds, and the least professional neighborhood watch. No mowers. Any breach fails the mission.
levels.joke: The mowers have requested a mental-health day. Neighborhood watch is currently watching from indoors.

levels.title: 1-11 · Interns at the Gate
levels.briefing: Five lanes, blocked flowerbeds, and the least professional neighborhood watch. Clear the fast waves within 340 seconds.
levels.joke: An internship with excellent exposure and no pulse. The HOA has banned brains after 9 PM.

levels.title: 1-12 · Crossword Violence
levels.briefing: Five lanes, blocked flowerbeds, and the least professional neighborhood watch. Cover the specialist wave; avoid relying on a single front wall.
levels.joke: This wave has read the terms and conditions. You have not. Your neighbor insists this is normal lawn aeration.

levels.title: 1-13 · Bring Your Own Salad
levels.briefing: Five lanes, blocked flowerbeds, and the least professional neighborhood watch. The supplied seed menu is fixed. Supplies are borrowed even if not yet unlocked.
levels.joke: The chef insists the menu is a tactical constraint. The fence contractor accepts payment in screams.

levels.title: 1-14 · Five Casualties Maximum
levels.briefing: Five lanes, blocked flowerbeds, and the least professional neighborhood watch. Lose no more than 5 plants. Transformations and deliberate single-use plants are exempt.
levels.joke: Five losses are a tragedy. Six are a failed level. A tasteful garden gnome has declined to intervene.

levels.title: 1-15 · The Graft Draft
levels.briefing: Five lanes, blocked flowerbeds, and the least professional neighborhood watch. Create at least 2 grafts and clear the waves. Same-plant twin hybrids count too.
levels.joke: Botany: now with legally questionable welding. Neighborhood watch is currently watching from indoors.

levels.title: 1-16 · Garden Artillery Club
levels.briefing: Five lanes, blocked flowerbeds, and the least professional neighborhood watch. No plants or seeds required. Click a board tile to fire a free recharging area cannon.
levels.joke: No plants today. The salad has authorized artillery. The HOA has banned brains after 9 PM.

levels.title: 1-17 · Fence Permit Pending
levels.briefing: Five lanes, blocked flowerbeds, and the least professional neighborhood watch. Dark crossed tiles cannot be planted. Zombies still travel through them.
levels.joke: These tiles are reserved for a future parking lot. Your neighbor insists this is normal lawn aeration. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns.

levels.title: 1-18 · The Night Shift Preview
levels.briefing: Five lanes, blocked flowerbeds, and the least professional neighborhood watch. No sky sun. Start from the supplied savings and plant your own economy.
levels.joke: Solar power at night: accounting would like a word. The fence contractor accepts payment in screams.

levels.title: 1-19 · Bucket List
levels.briefing: Five lanes, blocked flowerbeds, and the least professional neighborhood watch. Armor soaks projectiles. Save explosives for tightly grouped helmets.
levels.joke: Buckets protect brains, not fragile workplace morale. A tasteful garden gnome has declined to intervene. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns.

levels.title: 1-20 · Seed Packet Diet
levels.briefing: Five lanes, blocked flowerbeds, and the least professional neighborhood watch. Fixed four-seed deck and a total limit of 20 planting actions.
levels.joke: The seeds were packed by a minimalist. Neighborhood watch is currently watching from indoors.

levels.title: 1-21 · Save the Picnic
levels.briefing: Five lanes, blocked flowerbeds, and the least professional neighborhood watch. No planting; lose no more than 5 plants. A mature garden is provided. Protect it; click a damaged plant for a free 1200-HP repair every 3 seconds. Crafted tools are optional.
levels.joke: The garden is already planted. Your job description says keep it that way. The HOA has banned brains after 9 PM.

levels.title: 1-22 · Four Thousand Reasons
levels.briefing: Five lanes, blocked flowerbeds, and the least professional neighborhood watch. Collect a total of 4000 sun in this battle. Spending does not reduce this total.
levels.joke: Collect 4000 sun. Do not stare directly at the counter. Your neighbor insists this is normal lawn aeration. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns.

levels.title: 1-23 · The Unpaid Internship
levels.briefing: Five lanes, blocked flowerbeds, and the least professional neighborhood watch. Summoners and small runners require rear coverage, not just one front tank.
levels.joke: Fresh interns have arrived. Their onboarding is your problem. The fence contractor accepts payment in screams. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns.

levels.title: 1-24 · Neighborhood Meeting
levels.briefing: Five lanes, blocked flowerbeds, and the least professional neighborhood watch. Long mixed assault. Pace your economy: the waves never stop being polite about it.
levels.joke: The committee has decided to attack simultaneously. A tasteful garden gnome has declined to intervene. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns.

levels.title: 1-25 · Granite Eviction Notice
levels.briefing: Five lanes, blocked flowerbeds, and the least professional neighborhood watch. Two giant arrivals with a rebuilding window. Counter its special ability, then clear the field.
levels.joke: The giant brought a club. The homeowners association brought a fine. Neighborhood watch is currently watching from indoors. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns.
